summary: vmware.vmware_rest lookup plugins depend on cloud.common, which doesn't support ansible-core 2.19 or higher.
questions: Do vmware_rest lookup plugins work with ansible-core 2.19?
Why do vmware.vmware_rest lookups fail on Ansible 12?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest lookups and ansible-core 2.19
answer_card.answer_md: The `vmware.vmware_rest` lookup plugins use `cloud.common`, which **does not support ansible-core 2.19 or higher**, so they are affected on Ansible 12.
